clocks.supported_domain: one direct unit-rate constant-offset relation per clock pair with exact offset and nonnegative uncertainty in the stamps' unit; no priority, validity interval, rate, drift, selection or composition

exploratory_after_freeze.note: added after the frozen cases ran: the upstream fix clears the queue at the next control-loop start, after reset_completed, so it violates the frozen reset-time predicate while no stale action is dispatched; reported, not scored

findings.detail: generation 0: 0 of 2 opportunities units carried a dispatch (coverage 0.000 < 0.8)

chunk_identity.premise: a chunk id names one response; a different response under the same id is a conflict that the producer's admission decision resolves, and a queued action keeps the identity it was admitted with

premises: the chunk's first_step is the step its policy targeted (suite v2: the bound observation's step)
the dispatch step is the executed local consumption counter
alignment means the action ran at the step it targeted; software indices only, no physical state

retrospective.note: named after the retained traces were executed; not part of the frozen nine-predicate contract or of temporal_contract

observation_context.premise: the frozen rule fences prior requests, not prior observations; an observation from an earlier activation is reported, not scored

useful_execution.meaning: version-1 grid/opportunity coverage against useful_coverage_min, kept under its original name and denominator

changes: v3: clock declarations are parsed into a model with an explicit supported domain (one direct unit-rate constant-offset relation per clock pair); a pair declared with different relations is conflicting evidence in any order and leaves freshness unresolved unless same-clock chain evidence proves expiry

v3: malformed clock containers and members are named trace problems (invalid, never an exception); unsupported declaration fields, unit mismatches and undeclared clocks leave the pair unmapped and freshness unresolved; legacy forms are named rules

v3: a queued action keeps the chunk identity it was admitted with; a different response under the same chunk id is a conflict resolved by the producer's admission decision and reported under retrospective chunk_identity
configuration_binding follows the activation context derived from recorded configuration_changed transitions (a content hash that returns is a new context)
acknowledgement binds to the send attempt (dispatch_id), not to the action id
freshness adjudicates chronology explicitly: a mapped interval admitting negative ages is unresolved unless same-clock chain evidence bounds the age from below
age and grid arithmetic are exact (no float conversion of stamps)
assigned_usefulness reads the producer's frozen whole-case opportunity contract; useful_execution keeps the version-1 grid meaning under its original name
retrospective chunk_target_alignment and observation_context are reported outside the frozen nine-predicate contract
